content.short: Compound Blue provides DeFi lending and borrowing interface for Compound-managed deployments by Paperclip Labs.
content.description: Compound Blue is an open-source front-end that provides access to Compound's Morpho-powered vaults on the Polygon network. The platform lets users deposit assets, earn yield, and borrow directly from markets with improved efficiency, thanks to Morpho's optimization of capital use. These vaults are owned and managed by the Compound DAO and generate revenue through a performance fee applied to earned yields. Vault selections are curated by Gauntlet to balance risk and yield, while maintaining transparency as an open-source project.
content.meta: Compound Blue is an open-source front-end for accessing Compound's new Morpho-powered vaults on Polygon. Discover Compound Blue and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
